final_elements.name: feeder roof and hanger
final_elements.description: One peaked roof with a curved wire rising from its apex.

final_elements.name: feeder tray and posts
final_elements.description: Two side posts connect roof ends to a shallow tray.

final_elements.name: seed opening
final_elements.description: One open center window and small seed pile inside tray.

final_elements.name: perched bird
final_elements.description: One small bird perched on right tray rim with tail outside.

final_elements.name: wing and eye
final_elements.description: One curved wing and one visible eye on the bird.

frames.visible_job: Peaked roof and connected hanging wire
frames.instruction: Draw two sloping roof edges meeting at a peak; loop one wire upward from that peak.
Drop a post from each roof end and join their bottoms with a shallow tray curve.
Leave the middle between posts open; sketch a low seed mound resting on the tray.
Place a small oval bird on the right rim; add its short beak and a tail pointing out.

frames.visible_job: Add the curved bird wing and tiny visible eye
frames.instruction: Add a curved wing inside the bird oval and a tiny eye above its beak.

final_step.instruction: Darken existing roof, posts, tray, seeds and bird; shade lightly with visible pencil grain.

visual_review.draw_through_observation: Viewed the full raster sheet and six saved square crops. Roof and hanger stay at fixed anchors; posts and tray, seed mound, bird silhouette, then wing and eye are added cumulatively. No temporary guides, moved lines, or unexplained removals. The finish shades those contours only.
